review.scope: Unstabilized crystalline hexamine from aqueous formaldehyde and anhydrous liquid ammonia, evaporation/crystallization, centrifugation and drying, with actual complete coupled on-site stripper/CatOx producer obligation and original-cohort interfaces.
review.source_and_method: Root read retained USITC5660 full selected PDF73–77 with footnotes and viewed actual PDF76 Figure1.2, including FirstEffect -> Stripper/CatalyticOxidizer -> Distillate and pure versus additive product branches. Producer-derived examples do not become numerical defaults. Independent ATEC liquid-feed variant supports scope; missing ATEC image is not proof that treatment is absent. Root read full JECFA monograph and directly viewed original IS4306 PDF7–8 nonaqueous assay and loss-on-drying context. IS extraction is explicitly a manual locator map, not OCR/transcription; root pdftotext only produced page breaks. IS0.1401 and JECFA0.03505 method equivalences/sample conventions cannot mix. Whole aqueous feed crosses once; CH2O-equivalent assay is not free HCHO or free water. Real hydrate/oligomer/methanol and actual reaction/speciation evidence required.
review.native_and_classification: Actual whole state100 crystalline Hexamethylenetetramine CAS100-97-0 ProductMass/kg with exact Chinese六亚甲基四胺 has no hard grade/route/geography restriction. Polluted Chinese aliases and native34150 counter-classification disclosed. Current35230 heterocycle-family context, WCOHS2933.69 triazine heading and USITC explicitly named hexamine2933.69.50 support scoped interpretation. Old melamine terminal-Product hold remains unresolved. Actual complete treatment producer, phases, sources, compatible units and matrix qualification are not supplied; they block complete LCI/study use. This PCR states a substantive matched-producer modelling requirement and does not assert dataset availability, offsite disposal or a generic proxy.
review.event_stock_accounting: Original unique first acceptance Q and disjoint net fate bridge, full stocks and inherited WIP once, actual whole contaminated exports and non-overlapping provider service demand, separate asset/packaging physical fleets, actual quantities and original cohorts retained.
review.bilingual: Complete EN/ZH meaning and supported source/ancestor units reviewed; typed rules, calculations, quality and twelve-field protocols, source/use and ordered qualifiers compared.
review.remaining_limits: Actual providers, quantities, grades, full applicable site/matrix method qualification and unbound ordinary identities remain explicit study obligations. No generic-category proxy or empirical default; finite checks do not establish scientific approval or complete plant data.
